name: diagrams-so
description: Generate, edit, and manage cloud architecture diagrams (draw.io / SVG) with AI.
long_description: The Diagrams.so MCP server lets Claude generate cloud architecture diagrams from a prompt, review Well-Architected warnings, fix them, edit iteratively, search a public gallery, and export native .drawio / SVG — all through the Diagrams.so public API. Reads are free; generate/edit/fix cost credits.

api_key.title: Diagrams.so API Key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave blank and connect with one click on first use (or run `npx @diagrams-so/mcp login`). Only needed for CI/headless setups.

api_base.title: API Base URL
api_base.description: Advanced: override for local/self-hosted. Leave as default for production.

tools.name: generate_diagram
tools.description: Create a diagram from a prompt (costs credits).

tools.name: edit_diagram
tools.description: Apply a natural-language change (costs credits).

tools.name: fix_warning
tools.description: Resolve one Well-Architected warning (costs credits).

tools.name: relayout_diagram
tools.description: AI re-arrange the layout (async; first 2/diagram free, then confirm).

tools.name: import_diagram
tools.description: Import existing draw.io XML as a new diagram.

tools.name: update_diagram
tools.description: Rename, change visibility, or replace a diagram's XML.

tools.name: revert_diagram
tools.description: Revert a diagram to an earlier version.

tools.name: delete_diagram
tools.description: Soft-delete a diagram (destructive).

tools.name: fork_template
tools.description: Copy a public/library diagram into your account (private).

tools.name: get_diagram
tools.description: Fetch a diagram's XML + score.

tools.name: list_diagrams
tools.description: List your diagrams (paginated).

tools.name: get_warnings
tools.description: Well-Architected findings for a diagram.

tools.name: export_diagram
tools.description: Export a diagram as drawio or svg.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List a diagram's version history.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Fetch a specific version's XML + score.

tools.name: get_relayout_status
tools.description: Poll an async re-layout job.

tools.name: search_gallery
tools.description: Search public community + curated library diagrams.

tools.name: enhance_prompt
tools.description: Turn a rough idea into a detailed prompt.

tools.name: clarify_prompt
tools.description: Get clarifying questions for a vague prompt.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Plan, credits, and cost estimates.

tools.name: get_usage_history
tools.description: Itemized credit-consumption history per task, with filters (free).

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Account, plan, scopes, live/test mode.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Valid diagram types, providers, and export formats.
